advice.text: Keep 15 manual save slots in rotation: PowerPyx recommends a save at the start and the end of every chapter, because there is no mission replay.
advice.title: Save at every chapter boundary

advice.text: Cheats disable trophies and saving, according to PowerPyx, so keep them off your platinum save entirely.
advice.title: Cheats off, always

advice.text: Optional missions with black icons and pink letters disappear over time, but PowerPyx confirms that never blocks a trophy: there are far more than the 100 optional missions the checklist needs.
advice.title: Do optional missions as they appear

advice.text: Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study animals with binoculars from the start: 200 of 277 base vehicle models and 100 of 255 animals are needed for 100%.
advice.title: Scan and study from hour one

meta.note: Hours are estimates, labelled as such: PowerPyx puts the story at 60-80 hours and the whole platinum at about 200 hours; Push Square allows up to 300 hours. Every stage lists the trophies it earns, and every trophy in the guide sits in exactly one stage.

stages.note: Play Chapters 1 and 2 and learn the map. The one thing you must not skip is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia: it is the only possibly missable trophy in the game.
stages.title: Chapters 1-2: the story opens

stages.note: Play Chapters 3, 4 and 5 through the finale. The story alone takes around 60 hours (VGC, via PlanetGTA6). Pick up the stranger questlines as they open: Andy calls Lucia, Randy's wish list begins, Tyrone's labs appear.
stages.title: Chapters 3-5: the story closes

stages.note: Finish the five named stranger questlines and the eight qualifying stranger strands. None of these is missable: every quest giver stays available after the story.
stages.title: Strangers and side questlines

stages.note: Races, shooting ranges, drone races, stunts, arcade games, fishing, the plane stunt at VCIA and the tank at Mile Zero. Golds here also raise Focus, which the Gunslinger trophy needs.
stages.title: Activities and feats

stages.note: Bank vaults, armored trucks, jewelry stores, gang operations and the money trophies. Every vault robbery triggers 4-star heat, which also feeds the Hot Together escape.
stages.title: Robberies and money

stages.note: The long collectible grind: cards, WAiNK scans, vehicle discovery, challenges and full map exploration. The checklist only needs part of each set, so stop at its thresholds, not at 100% of everything.
stages.title: Collectibles and exploration

stages.note: Finish the 100% checklist, sweep up the two still-unconfirmed trophies if the community has found them by then, and the platinum pops with the last trophy earned.
stages.title: 100% checklist, cleanup, platinum

warnings.text: In Chapter 1, after the mission Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating in the morning. Talk to her in the kitchen, follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. This meditation becomes permanently unavailable after Chapter 1. PowerPyx is still confirming whether it counts toward the trophy, but do it anyway.
warnings.title: Point of no return: the Chapter 1 meditation
